Name: Warp Totems to Magic Book Tomes
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia]
[size=4][u]If you are mod author and would like to add retexture for your custom warp - DM me, I'll gladly help with it.
[/u]
Added retexture for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside VIllage[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13996?tab=files]Mineral Town[/url]﻿, [url=http:///www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12345]Durin's Rest[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11577]Aurora Vineyard custom obelisk[/url] warp totems!

[/size][/font][size=4][color=#ff7700][font=Georgia]Config:[/font]
[/color][font=Georgia]Treasure Totem - 1, 2, vanilla;
Wind Totem (SVE) - 1, 2, vanilla;
[/font][/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Rain Totem - 1, 2, vanilla;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Warp Totems - 1, 2, vanilla;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Warp Totem - Desert - 1purple, 2purple, 1yellow, 2 yellow, vanilla.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4][font=Georgia]

[/font][font=Georgia][b][u][color=#ff0000]IMPORTANT[/color][/u][/b]
[u]For some reason sometimes if you use Pytk or SpritesInDetail mods, book textures for custom warps (Ridgeside, Durin's rest and others) won't apply automatically. So in order for it to work You need to do this:[/u]

[list=1]
[*]Download Custom warps fix "Warp Totems to Magic Book Tomes" mod archive from "optional files" section
[*]Open mod archive and choose your desired book retextures (you don't need to install all, for example, if you only use Ridgeside - choose only ridgeside folders
[*]Open  desired "ModName ver1" or "ModName ver1" (chose one of 2 book retexture variants), copy "ModName" folder in it
[*]Go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods and paste the copied folder in it, confirm folder merging and file replacement.
[*] Done! (you need to do this after every time you update those expansion mods)
[/list][/font][/size][font=Georgia][size=4]

[u][color=#ff7700]Credits:[/color][/u]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Used book sprites from this [url=http://www.kindpng.com/imgv/hiiTJx_rpg-items-pixel-art-pixel-art-rpg-items/][b]free RPG sprite sheet[/b][/url] (I slightly recolored them and added emblems).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194104024-aztecviper/]AztecViper[/url] who made retextures for Treasure Totem, Wind Totem (SVE) and Cape Stardew Totem.
[/size][/font]
[/list][/font]
